Actual: ✔ Dashboard: h1 "Dashboard", active nav "Dashboard" | ✔ My Expenses: h1 "My expenses", active nav "My Expenses" | ✔ New Expense: h1 "New expense", active nav "New Expense" | ✔ Approvals: h1 "Manager approval", active nav "Approvals" | ✔ Finance: h1 "Finance overview", active nav "Finance"

expectedResult: Each route renders its expected page title and active navigation state.

expectedResult: Interactive controls have discernible labels and feedback is exposed through appropriate status or alert semantics.
